name: gencloud/bizzio-sync-for-woocommerce
description: WordPress plugin: Bizzio Sync for WooCommerce

scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: PHPCBF: auto-fix of the fixable PHPCS issues
scripts-descriptions.plugin-check: Plugin Check (PCP) via WP-CLI against the LocalWP test site (wp-cli.local.yml)
scripts-descriptions.plugin-check:strict: Plugin Check, only severity >= 5 (what blocks WP.org review)
scripts-descriptions.build: Build the distributable ZIP into ./build using .distignore
scripts-descriptions.version-check: Header/readme/constant/changelog versions agree (pass a tag to also compare it)
scripts-descriptions.hooks: Enable the repo git hooks (commit-msg + pre-push attribution guard)
scripts-descriptions.attribution-check: No Co-Authored-By / Generated-by / assistant attribution in commits not yet on main
